message.content: According to the conversation, LiHua expressed enthusiasm about diving back into "Call of Duty: Warzone" after the updates. In the dialogue, Thane Chambers mentions, "Sounds epic! I’m looking forward to the updates! Hopefully, they’ll shake things up and bring some fresh maps and modes. It’ll be exciting to see what new features they add. You think you'll dive back in when they drop?" To which LiHua responded, "Absolutely! I'm always up for something new in the game. I love exploring fresh content and teaming up with friends!" This clearly indicates that LiHua plans to play "Warzone" once the updates are released.
